recordingProfileCapture.artifactIntegrity: all 15 implementation images and 15 measurement records matched manifest byte counts and SHA-256 values
recordingProfileCapture.note: The Nx capture target ran both the app and E2E typecheck prerequisites before completing all 15 states. Every state required a real recording-desktop full-motion WebGL canvas, seed 43117, render readiness, and no observed context loss. Runtime errors and context loss are hard failures, and the complete size/SHA-256 manifest is published atomically.

currentLiveProfileProbe.qualification: Tablet and mobile are browser emulations, not physical-device or performance evidence. Main-thread context-loss events were monitored; worker and OffscreenCanvas context-loss state remains unknown.

comparison.reason: The whole four-row landing/journey DOM ladder passes all 13 applicable state contracts; loader-mark and world-reveal have no applicable DOM profile. The unmasked full-frame raster is only a preliminary diagnostic and passes 1 of 15 states. Structural accuracy is separately blocked for all 15 states because required authoritative source and implementation screen-space measurements are incomplete. Neither preliminary raster nor DOM success confers final visual acceptance.

validationSnapshot.details: Run with Node 24.14.0, matching CI and the declared jsdom-compatible engine range. App, E2E, and motion-system lint and typecheck passed.
The Pegasoft app passed 5 Vitest files and 35 tests; motion-system passed 1 Vitest file and 2 tests.
No legacy renderer, development query/diagnostic, recording evidence, or external scratch marker matched production JavaScript, CSS, JSON, or HTML.

Legacy, evidence, direct-control query, state/seed contract, recording, and external-scratch markers were absent. One private server source map retains two dynamic-import module path strings: hero-development-control and hero-development-diagnostics. The actual __heroState control contract is absent.

The restored 190835536-byte Git LFS recording matched SHA-256 de2d5e03a9bb8c1ef93278088f9f205b48710a3ce9568a648b96d619cfaeb321; schema 2 reproduced 4 landmark measurements, 7 explicit landmark blocks, 4 landmark-not-applicable classifications, 3 route-core measurements, and 1 section-boundary measurement byte-for-byte.

The final current-checkpoint run passed 30 Chromium and Mobile Chrome executions; the two opt-in Phase 19 performance probes were skipped. Genuine profile-aware desktop and mobile restored-reload convergence passed.

The genuine desktop and mobile profile executions passed 2/2 for forward, reverse, direct jump, resize, and restored-scroll reload convergence. ResizeObserver-backed page geometry updates cover post-hydration and reload layout changes.

The app typecheck and E2E typecheck prerequisites passed before all 15 recording-profile states were captured. Run 3ea50840-e8ad-439b-9ee9-e7e8bca3e24b completed at 2026-07-30T12:45:18.739Z and published a complete atomic size/SHA-256 manifest.

Schema 5 reports preliminary raster at 1 pass / 14 fail, structural accuracy at 0 pass / 0 fail / 15 blocked, and whole-ladder DOM at 13 pass / 0 fail / 0 blocked / 2 not applicable. The non-zero exit is required while structural and final visual acceptance remain blocked.

All four repository-owned current-live profiles passed. Tablet and mobile were emulated browser contexts; this is not physical-device or performance evidence, and worker/OffscreenCanvas context-loss state remains unknown.

resolvedFormerDebts: The fallback is state-specific rather than a generic four-block composition.
Unit direct-entry coverage iterates all 15 states.
The controller no longer publishes a fictitious settled-camera snapshot; the render adapter owns actual damping.
The production runtime imports the minimal runtime-state projection rather than the full evidence manifest.
Development controls and state/seed diagnostic contracts are absent from production executable assets; source maps retain two dynamic-import module path strings but no query/control contract.
Reduced motion uses demand rendering, immediate poses, no pointer trail, and discrete DOM handoffs.
ResizeObserver and visual-viewport resize signals keep page geometry current after mobile hydration, resize, and reload.
The duplicate 48px wrapper inset was removed; the single 48px steps-container inset now matches the authoritative whole-ladder DOM box.

blockingEvidence.issue: Deterministic recording measurement resolves 7 landmarks, 12 visible route cores, and 1 section boundary. All 12 applicable route states are measured; 3 route fields and 4 route/transition-primary landmark fields are correctly not applicable. Four landmark-primary states and additional source observables remain blocked. The repository-owned semantic masks remain tied to exact source-frame and mask hashes and completed their personal-review checkpoint without conferring visual acceptance. The current implementation passes all 13 applicable live DOM contracts, but generated implementation captures cannot substitute for missing source measurements.
The procedural world, route projection, static cameras, materials, lighting, effects, and geometry have not passed state-specific structural and visual tolerances.
Loader, landing packets, field pulse cadence, pointer-trail appearance, and arrival timing remain comparison candidates rather than accepted source matches.

The Phase 19 acceptance performance run remains unrun on locked hardware. An earlier development software-renderer diagnostic exceeded frame-time, long-task, and mobile CLS budgets and is not acceptance evidence.

acceptance.reason: The current architecture, deterministic controls, repeat capture, genuine desktop/mobile convergence matrix, and manifest integrity pass their local Phase 5 gate. Ordered acceptance remains held at Phase 1 because four landmark-primary states and additional source observables remain unmeasured; all 12 applicable route states are measured, 3 route fields and 4 route/transition-primary landmark fields are correctly not applicable, and the source-tied masks completed their personal-review checkpoint without conferring visual acceptance. The comparator separately reports only 1/15 preliminary raster states passing and all 15 structural states blocked, despite a 13/13 applicable whole-ladder DOM pass; final hero acceptance is therefore blocked.
